Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Identifying symbol for security. If the optional 48/22 tags are not sent, this tag will be required. If the optional 48/22 tags are sent as well, this tag will be ignored.

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Optional Symbol Suffix

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Optional CUSIP identifier

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Should contain "1" if a CUSIP was passed in SecurityID

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid value: 2 = Limit

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell short

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Valid values, in multiple combination: f = BXI (see chapter 2.2.12) G = All or none (AON) N = Non-negotiable (cannot be countered) b = Strict Limit (no price improvement allowed) s = Saturate on Expiration Z = Auto Cancel F = Fractional Share Trade Messages Accepted

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Valid values: 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC, message has expire time, either specified or default, but will cancel immediately following a partial execution)

Field.Name: Duration
Field.Description: The duration until message expires, in whole seconds. The minimum is 10 seconds. If no duration is specified then message will expire at 5:00:00 PM EST.

Field.Name: SolicitedFlag
Field.Description: Valid values: Y = Order is solicited - Default N = Order is not solicited

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Valid values: A = Agency P = Principal - Default R = Riskless Principal

Field.Name: PingECN
Field.Description: Indicates an IOC ECN order will first ping OTC Link ECN, before a trade message is sent to the selected MPID(s). Valid values: L = Ping at Trade Msg Limit Price M = Ping at CBBO Midpoint

Field.Name: BFMMFlag
Field.Description: Indicates trade message supports the bona fide market making exception in Regulation SHO. Valid values: Y = Supports the bona fide market making exception N = Does not support the bona fide market making exception - Default

Field.Name: CounterOrdID
Field.Description: Contains latest counter ID if message has been countered

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time when message was processed

Field.Name: QAPRate
Field.Description: Specifies the access fee or rebate rate for the trade. Set to 0 if no fee or rebate.

Field.Name: LiabilityFlag
Field.Description: Indicates if message's price matches or is better than Respondent's quote. Valid values: Y = matches or is better N = does not match or is worse

Field.Name: OrderQueuePosition
Field.Description: The number of trade messages the Respondent has received for this security at this price and side.

Field.Name: RestrictToRoundLots
Field.Description: Valid values: N = executions of odd lots allowed - Default Y = only executions of round lots are allowed

Field.Name: MaxOrderID
Field.Description: Only when a MAX message. A unique ID for the MAX trade group.
